name: Windmill
description: Search for scripts and flows, get their details, and execute them directly from Claude. Monitor job executions, retrieve logs, manage resources and variables, and control schedules. Windmill is an open-source platform for internal tools, workflows, and API integrations, supporting Python, TypeScript, Go, SQL, and more. Works with Windmill Cloud or self-hosted instances.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Windmill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Windmill to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.windmill.dev/api/mcp/gateway. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Windmill MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Windmill lists 14 MCP tools, including list_jobs, get_job, get_job_result, create_resource, get_resource, list_resources, update_resource, delete_resource, list_variable, create_variable, update_variable, and get_schedule.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Windmill?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Windmill in automation-workflows on the Manufact MCP catalog include Sidewave Maggiordomo, Corsair Cloud, Fleet Workspace, Whalesync, and typenode-mcp.
Windmill requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Windmill is developed by Windmill Labs Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
